SELECT pi.* FROM product_center.product_info pi INNER JOIN product_center.sku_item_combination sic ON pi.tenant_id = sic.tenant_id AND pi.product_code = sic.product_code AND pi.sub_product_code = sic.sub_product_code AND pi.billing_item_code = sic.billing_item_code AND pi.sub_billing_item_code = sic.sub_billing_item_code WHERE sic.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND sic.sku_code = #{skuCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND sic.sku_revision = #{skuRevision, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND pi.deleted = 0 ORDER BY pi.sort_order

SELECT sp.* FROM product_center.sku_pricing sp INNER JOIN product_center.sku_pricing_link spl ON sp.tenant_id = spl.tenant_id AND sp.pricing_code = spl.pricing_code AND sp.revision = spl.pricing_revision WHERE spl.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND spl.sku_code = #{skuCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND spl.sku_revision = #{skuRevision, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND spl.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY sp.priority DESC

SELECT ps.* FROM product_center.pricing_strategy ps INNER JOIN product_center.sku_pricing_strategy_link spsl ON ps.tenant_id = spsl.tenant_id AND ps.strategy_code = spsl.strategy_code WHERE spsl.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND spsl.sku_code = #{skuCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND spsl.sku_revision = #{skuRevision, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND spsl.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (spsl.effective_time IS NULL OR spsl.effective_time <= NOW()) AND (spsl.expiry_time IS NULL OR spsl.expiry_time >= NOW()) ORDER BY COALESCE(spsl.priority, ps.priority) DESC
